subject: PR #1037: intake of Leonxlnx/unlazy (linter+templates under third_party/) and vercel-labs/skills (evaluated, not adopted) + two hook denials — one VENDORED.md append overlaps #1019
body: Owner-shared 2026-09-24. Per the intake rule: each resource self-scanned the tree (worktree-isolated agents), four roster lenses confirmed/amended/rejected, the PM lens ranked; every claim measured in the sandbox with no keys. mac/intake-unlazy-skills @ dd8ad749, preflight PASSED. unlazy @ 16671491 (MIT): ADOPTED, non-executing half only — third_party/unlazy/ (7 files byte-identical at the pin + VENDORED.md with a 21-row Overrides table and the re-vendor recipe), publication-boundary area, .gitignore (.unlazy/, /skills-lock.json), and the doctrine as +28 lines in .claude/skills/orchestrator-over-workers/SKILL.md (worker spec = a leaf ledger linted with gate-lint --strict before dispatch; the orchestrator re-runs every CHECK: itself through Bash and quotes output; inherited ledgers are read, never run; ABANDON: is a handoff). REFUSED after measuring: the CHECK: executor (an in-tree command runner the PreToolUse deny hook cannot see — check-supervisor.mjs:16 spawns a shell over a string from an untracked file; approval binds PATH while the supervisor spawns with env: process.env), the Stop hook + installer (intake rule 3), scoped mode/leases, token-economy, and a .claude/skills landing (would move the vendored-set figures). vercel-labs/skills @ 7407f389: EVALUATED, NOT ADOPTED — measured on the published 1.7.0 tarball with the network denied (local add copies the whole skill dir + skills-lock.json, nothing in HOME, deterministic); remote paths are the unpinned fetch DR-026 refuses; -g installs escape every git-ls-files-derived gate. The refusal is now ENFORCED: .claude/hooks/block-dangerous.sh denies the two tokens (self-tested, check-hook-denylist green), and .claude/skills/VENDORED.md gains SEVEN refuse-only Overrides rows for nvidia-skill-finder's fenced/inline sites (SKILL.md:108/:118/:148/:154, evals/evals.json:10/:102/:117) — check-skill-instruction-conflicts went RED naming them with the hook change alone and is green with the rows. SHARED FILE: .claude/skills/VENDORED.md is in #1019's set — my seven rows are appends beside the existing :147 row, nothing rewritten; land #1037 whenever, it rebases trivially either side of #1019. The decision record for this intake + the hook change is a BUILD_BACKLOG row, to be appended only after #1019 and #1031 land (DR-054/DR-056 live there) — I will not type a number early. Not owner-gated except scripts/publication-boundary.mjs (one area line) → DR-037 owner/cloud merge. Also: the new hook token blocked my OWN commit command (the message named it inside a heredoc) — commit messages that mention a denied token now travel as a file; worth knowing for your lane too.
